triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: A validated B-5f5b implementation adds commands and tests proving full historical backfill creates only candidate playbooks, trial exposure records non-authoritative evidence, and timer automation delegates to guarded apply paths without bypassing activation evidence.
acceptanceBindings.note: The user-facing acceptance is the combined CLI closure, but each safety boundary is verified through checklist-specific intent refs.

note: B-5f5b ProofStory contract binds the requested backfill/trial/timer closure to all checklist verification intents while preserving inert candidates and evidence-only activation.
